_doc: The launch capability catalogue, design/gdd/kinh-mach-do.md rule 17. params are the numbers in each rule. npc_effect is the closed set in Formulas G.

capabilities.name: Song Khí Hợp Bích
capabilities.desc: Two magic treasures of the same kind work as a pair: +15% attack for the pair.

capabilities.name: Thần Thức Phân Hóa
capabilities.desc: +1 magic treasure slot and +20% divine sense.

capabilities.name: Dưỡng Bảo Nội Thể
capabilities.desc: The first equipped treasure costs no divine sense and grows +1% per year, up to +50%.

capabilities.name: Huyết Ngự Linh
capabilities.desc: 20% of vitality counts as spiritual power; below 30% vitality, -20% attack.

capabilities.name: Linh Hồn Xuất Khiếu
capabilities.desc: Once per realm, survive a death in an event at 5% vitality, losing one stage.

capabilities.name: Song Tu Công Pháp
capabilities.desc: A second main method at 50% speed with its full bonuses.

capabilities.name: Thai Tức Quy Nguyên
capabilities.desc: Age at three-quarters speed during closed-door cultivation.

capabilities.name: Mộng Trung Ngộ Đạo
capabilities.desc: Seasons spent travelling also cultivate, at 50% rate.

capabilities.name: Hấp Tinh Đại Pháp
capabilities.desc: Defeating a cultivator gives cultivation base worth 5% of the current stage; heart demon +2.

capabilities.name: Đan Hỏa Phân Lô
capabilities.desc: Brew two recipes in one season.

capabilities.name: Dị Đan Hóa Sinh
capabilities.desc: A failed brew has a 30% chance of a random lesser pill instead of ash.

capabilities.name: Bách Thảo Tàng Linh
capabilities.desc: Harvested herbs keep aging in the bag at half speed.

capabilities.name: Phù Lục Bất Tận
capabilities.desc: 30% chance a used talisman is not consumed.

capabilities.name: Động Phủ Tùy Thân
capabilities.desc: Formations and spirit fields work wherever you are; the field can be tended anywhere.

capabilities.name: Trận Trung Trận
capabilities.desc: Formations may exceed their maximum by 2 levels; upkeep for those levels x2.

capabilities.name: Vạn Thú Đồng Tâm
capabilities.desc: +2 spirit beasts kept; loyalty never drops below 30.

capabilities.name: Thú Hồn Hợp Thể
capabilities.desc: The strongest spirit beast adds its full combat power instead of half.

capabilities.name: Thiên Cơ Diễn Toán
capabilities.desc: See every choice's success and failure outcomes before choosing.

capabilities.name: Khí Vận Chi Tử
capabilities.desc: Once per realm, reroll a failed event check.

capabilities.name: Liễm Tức Ẩn Thân
capabilities.desc: Others see you two stages lower; hostile events -30% frequency.

capabilities.name: Thuấn Di Ấn
capabilities.desc: Once a year, travel instantly to any visited place.

capabilities.name: Hồi Quang Phản Chiếu
capabilities.desc: With under 5 years of lifespan left, one pill attempt per realm is up to x2, capped.

capabilities.name: Thiêu Thọ Phá Cảnh
capabilities.desc: After a failed pill attempt, burn 10 years (5% of the realm's lifespan if more) to retry at once.

capabilities.name: Biến Dị Khai Mở
capabilities.desc: Each completed realm breakthrough gives one more roll to every unowned, non-declined derived variant whose requirement is met.

capabilities.name: Tâm Ma Hóa Lực
capabilities.desc: Heart demon above 50 adds attack; qi deviation chance x2.
